About the Project

Edinburgh’s E5 NERC Doctoral Training Partnership supports environmental research. Applicants are encouraged to discuss their chosen project with its supervisor before applying.

Research Areas

  • Environmental science and related interdisciplinary research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull tuition including Edinburgh’s International fee-gap coverage; research costs.
MaintenanceGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference; updated annually)
DurationUp to 4 years

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant 2:1-equivalent degree; a Master’s is not required. Up to 30% of the intake may be International. English requirements apply; evidence is not required at the initial application. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentTimetable published; opening status to be checked
Deadline2 December 2026, 12:00 GMT; supplied guide gives 20 October 2026 noon for student-led proposals

How to Apply

Contact the chosen project supervisor early and follow E5’s application-process guidance when the application opens.

The official timetable confirms 2 December, while the page still describes recruitment as opening soon. The separate student-led-proposal date requires confirmation.

About The University of Edinburgh

The University of Edinburgh offers doctoral research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and health. Its research schools host scholarship competitions and doctoral training programmes with different admission and funding routes.

Official details: Programme information

Application route: Application form or official instructions
